descriptions.preferred: The leaves of this cultivar are divided deeply, with the seven lobes separated almost to the leaf base. The leaf base is usually truncate. Although occasionally, on new shoots of very vigorous plants, the leaves are up to 9 cm long, they are usually about 5-6 cm long and 6-7 cm wide. Each lobe is long-ovate, broadest in the middle— about 15 mm wide—and narrowing to about 4 mm at the lobe junctions. The tip comes to a long, narrow point. The leaves have an open, lacy appearance. The margins are deeply double toothed. The spring and early summer coloration is a deep, rich bronze red. The midvein in each lobe is a contrast- 10-15 years. It does, however, broaden out and form more of a round-topped, large bush. It is sturdy and quite hardy, and responds very well to pruning and shaping. It is quite satisfactory grown as a container plant. It can be slowed in its growth to a fine specimen or adapted to a larger bonsai type. This cultivar is not widely known.

rhs.description: A small, spreading, deciduous tree to around 4m tall with deeply divided, seven-loned leaves that emerge a rich bronze-red in spring with bright green veining. In summer the leaves are reddish with green veining and the autumn foliage is bright gold with crimson-red tints

attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。

rhs_zh.description: 小型、开展的落叶乔木，高约 4 米。叶片深裂，通常为七裂，春季萌发时呈浓郁的铜红色，并带鲜绿色叶脉。夏季叶片呈带红色调，叶脉仍为绿色；秋叶则转为明亮的金色，并带深红色晕染。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种叶片分裂很深，7 枚裂片几乎一直分离到叶基。叶基通常为截形。虽然在生长特别旺盛植株的新梢上，叶片偶可长达 9 厘米，但通常长约 5-6 厘米、宽约 6-7 厘米。每个裂片均为长卵形，中部最宽，约 15 毫米，在裂片连接处收窄至约 4 毫米，先端延伸为细长尖头。叶片整体显得开张而细致，颇具蕾丝感。叶缘为深重锯齿。春季和初夏叶色为深而浓郁的铜红色。每个裂片的中脉形成鲜明对比。植株在 10-15 年内保持良好形态；不过随着年龄增长，它会逐渐开展，形成更偏圆头状的大型灌木。该品种健壮且相当耐寒，对修剪和整形反应良好。作为容器植物栽培也很理想。可通过控长培养成精致标本株，也可塑造成较大的盆景类型。该品种尚不广为人知。
